theorem frontier_cover (old new : Nat → Prop) (n : Nat) (subset : ∀ i, i < n → old i → new i) : ((∀ i, i < n → new i) ∧ ¬ (∀ i, i < n → old i)) ↔ ∃ j, Region old new n j
theorem frontier_unique (old new : Nat → Prop) (n j k : Nat) (a : Region old new n j) (b : Region old new n k) : j = k
